question: What should recovery do after the overflow when the selected name contains invalid dC? Can it reconstruct and replay every missed generation?

criteria.instruction: Overflow requires full reconciliation of the current selected name. Invalid dC must not replace the last valid generation 41/dA; expose a sanitized failure and retain it. Missing or unreadable candidates also retain valid state. Reopen/read/validate/install is atomic at the configuration level. The missing event history does not establish every intermediate state or that dB was adopted.
Join overflow/dC observations with W7 and pending repair review. A restart may reopen a name but cannot authorize invalid dC or reconstruct a lost event sequence.
Refuse to fabricate missed generations, report successful repair from heartbeat alone, or disable validation to force adoption.
